order_rationale: Twelve fresh triplets include each run order twice and keep the frozen base/candidate order balanced and alternating.
frozen_gate: Candidate must reduce median paired elapsed time by at least 20% versus the frozen baseline in the target, with a 95% upper ratio below one and no other pooled profile above 5% median regression.
batch_gate: Candidate must reduce time versus the published runtime in the target with a 95% upper ratio below one and no other pooled profile above 5% median regression.
parity: Every paired variant must have identical ordered state and counters on the unchanged benchmark tape.
runner: Physical Intel i3-N300 Linux with one exclusive non-SMT cache cluster of CPUs 4-7; same binaries, operating mode and partition in each triplet.
metrics: Total and dispatch wall-clock nanoseconds from the executable; process peak RSS in KiB from GNU time.
